definitions.ask: How wide should a preview-less custom gate get on a wide terminal?
definitions.why: Doubles the readable line length but stays under half of a very wide screen

choices.label: Up to 120 columns, twice today's 60 on a ~264-column screen
Up to 100 columns; shorter lines but more wrapping and scrolling
Up to 140 columns; least wrapping, but long prose lines on very wide screens

definitions.ask: Should custom and sudo gates with a preview also widen their left Context/Decision rail on wide terminals?
definitions.why: Preview gates have the same cramped 42-column notes column; one CSS rule fixes it

choices.label: Rail takes 35% of the body (42-72 columns); 120-column goldens stay unchanged
Rail stays fixed at 42 columns; only preview-less gates change
